title: Projection-defined constant-tower derived-limit unit
statement:
Let $T$ be a scheme and $A,I,A_T$ an adic coefficient datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Put $\mathcal A=\operatorname{Mod}(A_T)$ and $\operatorname{Tow}(\mathcal A)=\operatorname{Fun}(\mathbf N_{\geq1}^{\mathrm{op}},\mathcal A)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-inverse-system]. Let $\Delta$ be the exact constant-tower functor and $\Delta_D$ its termwise derived functor [lem-weil-tower-category-levelwise-abelian, lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization]. Use the derived localizations $Q_{\mathcal A},Q_{\operatorname{Tow}}$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Fix a functorial K-injective tower resolution $\iota_M:M\to J(M)$, with K-injective meaning that maps from acyclic tower complexes are null-homotopic [def-pur-kinjective-complex], and let $\mathcal L=R\lim$ be its total derived inverse-limit functor [prop-weil-pbc-rlim-functoriality]. For a complex $C$ the components of $\iota_{\Delta C}$ factor uniquely through the ordinary degreewise inverse limit, giving $z_C:C\to\lim_nJ(\Delta C)_n$ with $\pi_nz_C=(\iota_{\Delta C})_n$.
Under the fixed localization comparisons $Q_{\mathcal A}(\lim J(\Delta C))\cong\mathcal L\Delta_D(Q_{\mathcal A}C)$, the maps $Q_{\mathcal A}(z_C)$ descend to a natural transformation
$$\eta:\mathrm{id}_{D(\mathcal A)}\longrightarrow\mathcal L\Delta_D.$$
For every derived morphism $h:C\to D$ one has $\mathcal L\Delta_D(h)\eta_C=\eta_Dh$. This is the projection-defined constant-tower map specified in [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback], without a choice of a morphism between unrelated triangulated cones.

proof.text: Use the existing degreewise functors L = mapHomologicalComplex(constantTower) and R = mapHomologicalComplex(completedTowerLimit). The ordinary constant/limit adjunction induces an adjunction L ⊣ R on complexes, with unit u whose degree-i component is the limit lift of the identity cone. All required limits exist in module sheaves.

Define z as u followed by R applied to the resolution transformation on L. The projection equation for lim.map and the equation for the unit limit lift give (z_C)^i followed by projection n equal to the nth component of iota_(L C). Any other map with these projections equals z_C by limit.hom_ext in each degree and HomologicalComplex.Hom.ext.
The complex-level adjunction unit is natural. Whiskering iota with L and R gives a natural transformation, so their composite z is natural. This uses functoriality of J only, without additivity.

Take eta to be the unit of the existing constantRlimAdjunction. Apply Adjunction.derivedη_fac_app to the homotopy-category constant/limit adjunction. Its left localization comparison is mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh and its right comparison is completedRlimUnit. The unit-on-quotient lemma and the comparison-on-complexes lemma identify its formula with eta_(Q C) followed by Rlim(phi_C) = Q(u_C) followed by completedRlimUnit_(L C). This reuses the derived adjunction already constructed in completed pullback, rather than constructing a second descent.

Compose the preceding equality with Rlim(Q(iota_(L C))). Naturality of completedRlimUnit at the homotopy class of iota_(L C) rewrites the right side as Q(u_C followed by R(iota_(L C))) followed by completedRlimUnit_(J(L C)), which is the required Q(z_C) formula. No invertibility of these maps is needed for this equality.

The final formula for every derived morphism is the naturality equation of the specified adjunction unit eta. Thus the same eta satisfies both the prescribed resolution comparison and derived naturality.

The statement is byte-identical to the live node, the live item is still unsplit, and the item has no repair note and is not on any dropped list. I read every cited statement in full. The specified map is exactly the one prescribed in def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback: take a tower K-injective resolution and factor its components through lim I_n. Steps 1-3 build H = lim J degreewise and the map z_C using the module-limit leaf (Stacks 03DB/03CO), the tower-morphism condition with identity transitions, and naturality of ι. Joint monicity of the projections gives naturality on complexes. Step 4: Δ is exact because exactness is levelwise. β is the composite of the exact-functor comparison with the fixed comparison Q_A H ≅ Rlim Q_Tow for the same J (prop-weil-pbc-rlim-functoriality). Because β is natural, B inverts quasi-isomorphisms. Step 5 applies localization clause (2) with F1 = Q_A, F2 = G Q_A, F1' = id and F2' = G; I checked this against Mathlib liftNatTrans_app. Step 6 reads off the specification. The parent's Step 7 uses exactly this derived-morphism naturality. The coefficient category is Mod(A_T) with completed coefficients, and no η-iso claim is made. Small cases checked: C = 0, an acyclic C, a single-degree C, the identity map and empty T. The cited Stacks tags 079P, 03DB, 03CO and 04VG are verified, and no SGA is cited. No duplicates were found in a grep of all constant-tower nodes; the adjunction-unit nodes use a different construction. There are no cycles. I accept the declared tool use of prop-weil-pbc-rlim-functoriality, from unit sk-thm-properbasechange, as a generic Rlim functor that replaces no CBC route step. Advisory only: tower K-injectivity cites def-pur-kinjective-complex, which is stated for modules on a site, but the item spells the meaning out inline. Review written to review.md; no fixes.
